hypothesis: M182 produced a robustness-passing source-diverse boundary wrong-history surface. Before PPO, the accepted rows must be converted into a deduplicated boundary-outcome corpus/objective and shown to be replay-aligned rather than only a fixed-loss proxy.
success_criteria: build the corpus only from M182 robustness-passing accepted wrong-history rows
deduplicate or cap rows by strict physical pair so no single pair dominates
keep the actor input contract unchanged and use M182 labels only as training-time objective data
prove objective-only improvement on the M182 corpus without regressing existing behavior/protected-key checks
run a fixed replay or replay-guard sanity check before admitting any PPO update
failure_criteria: train PPO directly from M182 accepted rows
use duplicate rows without physical-pair caps
accept fixed objective loss improvement without replay alignment
change deployable actor inputs or add hidden/oracle actor features

commands.name: m183_build_m182_boundary_corpus
commands.command: Build a deduplicated boundary outcome corpus from runs/m182_boundary_robustness_seed9510/accepted_wrong_history_rows.csv.

commands.name: m183_objective_sanity
commands.command: Run objective-only sanity from the current admitted branch and require fixed objective improvement plus replay/protected-key preservation.

decision_rule: Only a replay-aligned objective sanity result can admit a guarded actor update or PPO continuation.
